user.title: Rejseplanen Labs
user.description: Get a free API key at {labs_url}. Choose whether this instance follows a person/tracker or sits at a fixed location. Each update costs API quota, so prefer a longer interval (or on-demand only) and use the refresh button when you actually need fresh data.

data.on_demand_only: Only update on demand (ignore the interval; refresh via the button or the rejseplanen_labs.refresh service)

error.tracked_entity_required: Pick an entity to follow, or switch to a fixed location.
error.coordinates_required: Enter both latitude and longitude for a fixed location.
